title: Foot Tapping for Guitar Beginners: How to Keep Time by Tapping Your Foot
summary: In this JustinGuitar lesson, the instructor explains why players tap their foot to establish an external pulse that helps them keep time while playing guitar. He emphasizes that the heartbeat is not a reliable tempo source, and introduces the idea of using a metronome later in the course. The video covers where and how to tap—preferring a heel tap with the left foot for right-handed players to avoid the guitar jumping and disrupting chord changes—and discusses alternatives (toe taps, standing or seated tapping, even unconventional body movements). A core message is to practice tapping along with music to develop a subconscious sense of beat, with practical homework such as tapping any time there’s music (excluding car scenarios) and gradually integrating rhythm with chord changes and picking. The lesson culminates in guidance on public pacing and the long-term beginner journey from finger pain to rhythmic accuracy.

sections.title: Foot tapping to feeling the music
